title: Ether Cyclone
audit_comment: ETHER CYCLONE, printed p. 17: the sinuous storm of the Deep Ethereal - the 50% warning (the 1d6-round deep-hum herald), the one-roll-per-group doctrine, the d20 effects from the disrupted flow (+4 hours, one extra encounter check) through the curtain blows (the random Border, and the farther-plane +5d12 days) to the saving throw of the lowest-level member (success: an unexplored section with 10d12 days added; failure: the Astral tumble, as plane shift, no silver cord), and the aftermath: the Prime fallback saves, the inner-plane Border stop, and the demi-plane of Time caveat.

consts.name: dedCycloneWarningChance
consts.comment: the warning chance: fifty percent of the time travelers receive warning of the approaching cyclone - 1d6 rounds of it - the other fifty percent, none at all. The warning sign is a deep hum in the ethereal matter underneath, portions ripped away by the approaching storm.

consts.name: dedCycloneWarningRoundsHigh
consts.comment: the warning, when it comes, gives 1d6 rounds before the cyclone strikes - time to reach a safe haven: another plane, a demi-plane, the Border Ethereal, or a curtain.

consts.name: dedCycloneDisruptedHigh
consts.comment: the first d20 band, 1-10: the flow of the ether is disrupted - add four hours (one additional encounter check) to the travel time.

consts.name: dedCycloneDisruptedHours
consts.comment: the disrupted-flow band adds four hours to the travel time - one additional encounter check.

consts.name: dedCycloneCurtainHigh
consts.comment: the second d20 band, 11-15: the party is blown through a curtain into the Border Ethereal of a random plane or demi-plane - the usual encounter check for crossing a curtain, and the journey must begin again.

consts.name: dedCycloneFartherHigh
consts.comment: the third d20 band, 16-18: blown through a curtain into the Border Ethereal of a random plane farther from the original destination - the journey restarts with 5d12 days added.

consts.name: dedCycloneFartherDaysDice
consts.comment: the farther-plane blow adds 5d12 days to the total travel time.

consts.name: dedCycloneFartherDaysSides
consts.comment: the farther-plane blow's added days roll 5d12.

consts.name: dedCycloneSaveHigh
consts.comment: the fourth d20 band, 19-20: the saving-throw band.

consts.name: dedCycloneLostDaysDice
consts.comment: the 19-20 save made: the party is blown far from their tracks to an unexplored section of the Ethereal - 10d12 days added to reach any other plane or destination.

consts.name: dedCycloneLostDaysSides
consts.comment: the unexplored-section blow's added days roll 10d12.

bools.name: dedCycloneGroupRoll
bools.comment: one roll per group: all caught in the cyclone suffer the same d20 effects - though the aftermath saves are per member.

bools.name: dedCycloneLowestLevelSaves
bools.comment: the 19-20 band: the lowest-level member of the party makes the saving throw vs. spell - success blows the party to an unexplored section, failure blows the entire party into the Astral plane.

bools.name: dedCycloneAstralNoCord
bools.comment: the failed-save tumble into the Astral is as for plane shift and does not require a silver cord.

bools.name: dedCyclonePrimeFallback
bools.comment: blown through a curtain into the Border Ethereal of the Prime or a hospitable demi-plane: each member saves vs. spell - success remains in the Border, failure flings the individual back into the Prime plane or demi-plane, no longer ethereal or invisible.

bools.name: dedCycloneInnerBorderStop
bools.comment: travelers blown through a curtain into an inner plane or an inhospitable demi-plane stop in the Border Ethereal and are not transported into the plane.

bools.name: dedCycloneTimeBorderDanger
bools.comment: the Border Ethereal is dangerous in its own right in some cases - the demi-plane of Time is the book's named example.
